stem:
Rita had two boxes of ribbons.

• She had 37 large ribbons in the first box.
• She had 56 small ribbons in the second box.
• She gave 28 of the large ribbons to her sister.

Which number sentence can be used to find the number of ribbons Rita had left in the two boxes?
visual_elements: Number sentences labeled F, G, H, J with addition and subtraction expressions involving 37, 56, 28.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding which operations to perform to find how many ribbons are left after giving some away, involving multiple steps and reasoning about subtraction and addition.
